A_original.description: Builds a professional, corporate-style PDF performance report for one social platform (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube) from uploaded analytics exports — computing engagement rate, CTR, follower growth, and revenue, benchmarking against industry defaults, and rendering through a locked template so every month's report looks identical. Use this whenever the user asks to build, generate, or update a social media report for a platform and time period ("build a Facebook report for August," "generate the 2026 yearly Instagram report"), or uploads platform analytics exports and asks to analyze, compare, or summarize the numbers — even if they don't say the word "report."

results.query: can you crunch the numbers in this youtube studio export (views, CTR, RPM) and tell me how the channel did last month vs the two before
compare these two facebook insights csvs and tell me if reach actually went down or if it's just because february is shorter
our social manager wants the monthly IG numbers wrapped up — engagement, reach, revenue — from the xlsx i just dropped in
analyze this tiktok creator export and tell me which videos drove follower growth in august
our youtube RPM fell in the september export vs august — is that a real drop or noise? files are in uploads
pull together the monthly facebook performance summary for the client from the exports in uploads, same layout as always
which instagram month this summer had the best engagement rate? the insights exports are uploaded
the tiktok numbers for september are in — how are we tracking against industry benchmarks for engagement?
can you produce the Q3 youtube channel report as a pdf, using the three studio exports I dropped in
our instagram engagement has been dropping for months — give me 5 content ideas to turn it around
convert uploads/facebook_export_2026-08.csv to an xlsx with a frozen header row, nothing else
what's the difference between reach and impressions on facebook?
write a linkedin post announcing our record instagram growth this quarter
build a monthly shopify sales performance pdf report from the orders export

B_loop_iter2.description: Use this when the user has analytics exports (CSV/XLSX, or a prior PDF report) from Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube and wants the numbers turned into insight — comparing periods, explaining whether a metric's move is real or just a calendar artifact (like reach "dropping" because February is shorter), computing engagement rate, CTR, follower growth, and revenue, and benchmarking against industry norms — or wants those numbers assembled into a polished, client-ready PDF report for a given platform and time period. Triggers on requests to build, generate, update, analyze, compare, explain, or summarize social platform performance data, even without the word "report" and even for a quick comparison between two export files rather than a formal report. One platform per run. Not for general-purpose charting or spreadsheet cleanup unrelated to these four platforms, content calendars, captions, ad-account issues, posting automation, or API scripts to pull the underlying stats.
